products.name: NUMUW Diagnostic
products.purpose: Clarify the problem and priorities before building or buying anything
products.buyer: Business owner or decision-maker who knows something is wrong but cannot name it
products.trigger: Unclear priorities, scattered efforts, or pressure to 'do something digital'
products.problem: Buying the wrong package wastes money and time
products.bestFit: Company has a real problem but needs clarity on where to start
products.notFit: Company needs immediate execution without diagnosis
products.acceptance: Client understands the priority sequence and starting point
products.ownership: Client owns the diagnostic output and recommendations
products.nextStep: Digital Kickoff or relevant product based on diagnosis
products.exitHandoverPath: Client can act on recommendations independently or engage NUMUW for implementation

products.name: Digital Kickoff
products.buyer: Business that needs a clear starting asset they own
products.trigger: No website, outdated presence, or unclear digital foundation
products.problem: Scattered or missing digital assets that cannot be built upon
products.bestFit: Company needs one solid foundation asset
products.ownership: Client owns all delivered assets and accounts
products.exitHandoverPath: Client operates independently; optional Growth Partner for optimization

products.name: Automation Sprint
products.buyer: Operations or marketing team with a known repetitive process
products.trigger: Identified repetitive task consuming significant time
products.problem: Manual repetition that can be automated with clear boundaries
products.bestFit: One workflow with clear inputs, outputs, and decision points
products.notFit: Vague 'we need AI' without specific process
products.acceptance: Workflow runs successfully with documented error paths
products.ownership: Client owns the automation and documentation
products.licensing: Client owns output; third-party tool subscriptions separate

products.name: Growth System
products.purpose: Connect multiple layers when the problem is systemic
products.buyer: Business with interconnected gaps across message, presence, demand, and operations
products.problem: Fragmented growth efforts with no connecting logic
products.notFit: Single clear problem solvable by one product
products.acceptance: System operates with connected metrics and documented handover
products.ownership: Client owns all assets, accounts, and documentation
products.licensing: Perpetual for deliverables; third-party services billed separately
products.paymentSemantics: Milestone-based: 30% upfront, 40% at mid-point, 30% on acceptance
products.exitHandoverPath: Client operates independently; optional Growth Partner

products.name: Growth Partner
products.purpose: Recurring optimization after a useful baseline exists
products.buyer: Business with existing assets and data seeking continuous improvement
products.trigger: Baseline exists but optimization requires dedicated ongoing attention
products.notFit: No baseline or unclear problem statement
products.acceptance: Monthly report showing changes and learning
products.ownership: Client retains all assets; NUMUW operates improvement cycle
products.nextStep: Continuous until client takes over or engagement ends
products.exitHandoverPath: Client can end monthly cycle; retains all assets and learning

tools.name: Solution Finder
tools.purpose: Route to the right starting point when problem is unclear
tools.question: Where should I start?
tools.formulas: Decision tree based on goal × clarity × speed × business
assumptions: Sector is a meaningful routing signal
limitations: Not a substitute for diagnostic conversation
Sector is guidance not hard rule
tools.nextStep: Relevant product page or Brief Builder

tools.name: Automation Finder
tools.purpose: Estimate whether a repeated process is worth automating
tools.question: Is this workflow worth automating?
tools.formulas: monthlyTime = frequency * people * timePerOccurrence; monthlyCost = monthlyTime * hourlyRate; potentialSaving = monthlyCost * automationPercent/100
limitations: Does not include implementation or maintenance cost

tools.name: ROI Scenario
tools.purpose: Theoretical financial scenario under different assumptions
tools.question: What happens under different financial assumptions?
tools.formulas: roi = (benefit - cost) / cost * 100; monthlyBenefit = benefit / months; payback = cost / (benefit / months)
assumptions: Does not distinguish revenue vs avoided cost vs labor value
tools.nextStep: Validate assumptions with real baseline data

tools.name: Project Estimator

tools.question: What might the project contain?
assumptions: Prices are starting points not final quotes

tools.name: 90-Day Roadmap

limitations: Does not account for dependencies beyond goal type
